newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post Business - Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post Business - Oct 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its Tuesday's business section:
WASHINGTON - Rite Aid Corp., the largest drug store chain in the U.S., said it will buy West Coast competitor Thrifty PayLess Inc. in a $2.3 billion deal.
NEW YORK - As the dust settles from the clash of the news titans in New York City, Rupert Murdoch finds himself in the unfamiliar position of being denied a cable television outlet.
WASHINGTON - Gannett Co. has asked the Patent and Trademark Office to declare "Weenie of the Week," a term coined by late television sportscaster Glenn Brenner, a legally protected slogan.

WASHINGTON - Whatever else is remembered years from now about the Clinton administration's first term, on one point historians are likely to agree -- the White House created a heap of work for lawyers.
